author: More Perfect Union
description:
We got Amazon's own chatbot to snitch on Amazon.

We worked with a researcher to grill Walmart and Amazon's AI bots on the companies' Made in America labeling.

The bots revealed that Amazon and Walmart both made a calculated decision to let sellers lie about where products are made — because the business incentive to do so is larger than the legal risk of the FTC coming after them.

Producer/Host: yuremaperezhinojosa
Editor: kungaaaaaaaa
Videographer: Evan Carter
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Amazon’s AI Chatbot Just Snitched on Amazon

Jared Kushner has a scheme to profit off world peace — and Gaza is the testing ground.

There’s a web of private equity billionaires with ties to Israel and shadowy corporate armies who stand to profit off never-ending conflict.

We investigated Trump’s Board of Peace.
